text: At noon the Student opened his window. <break time="0.8s" /> And saw the red rose. <break time="0.8s" /> What a wonderful piece of luck. <break time="0.8s" /> He cried. <break time="0.8s" /> Here is a red rose. <break time="0.8s" /> He picked the rose. <break time="0.8s" /> Put on his hat. <break time="0.8s" /> And ran to the Professors house. <break time="0.8s" /> The Professors daughter. <break time="0.8s" /> Was sitting in the doorway. <break time="0.8s" /> Winding blue silk on a reel. <break time="0.8s" /> You said that you would dance with me. <break time="0.8s" /> If I brought you a red rose. <break time="0.8s" /> Cried the Student. <break time="0.8s" /> But the girl frowned. <break time="0.8s" /> And said that the rose would not go with her dress. <break time="0.8s" /> Besides the Chamberlains nephew. <break time="0.8s" /> Has sent me some real jewels. <break time="0.8s" /> She said. <break time="0.8s" /> Everybody knows. <break time="0.8s" /> That jewels cost far more than flowers. <break time="0.8s" /> The Student became angry. <break time="0.8s" /> And threw the rose into the street. <break time="0.8s" /> Where a cart wheel went over it. <break time="0.8s" /> What a silly thing Love is he said. <break time="0.8s" /> As he walked away. <break time="0.8s" /> It is not half as useful as Logic. <break time="0.8s" /> Because it does not prove anything. <break time="0.8s" /> So he went back to his room. <break time="0.8s" /> Took out a big dusty book. <break time="0.8s" /> And began to read.
